verdict.rationale: Secureframe runs several background processes on its own: daily continuous monitoring with alerts for failing tests, automated evidence collection through integrations, and automatic shadow-IT detection via SSO. Users can also configure recurring access and vendor reviews, reminders, and follow-up tasks that sync to ticketing tools. However, these are fixed, built-in compliance automations rather than user-defined automations or autonomous agent workflows. missing for 10: general user-configurable automation/workflow builder (custom triggers and actions), autonomous AI agents acting in the background, independent or hands-on corroboration.
